set.body:
Type: implementation task
Work key: CX05.1
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: GET /v1/datasets/{d}/releases/{r} returns parent and acceptedAt but not why or by whom the release was accepted, though both are recorded at acceptance.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Release response adds acceptance provenance: candidate id, reason, accepting principal, and the corrected path(s), with null for imported (non-correction) releases.
2. Disclosure follows existing authority: provenance is visible only with dataset metadata authority; principals render as ids until F05.3 lookup exists.
3. docs/http-api.md documents the fields; contract tests cover correction, import and denied cases; ConsoleSuite/persistence checks still pass.

Verification: `sbt http/test` and integration TransactionSuite; `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/scala/sanctity/http/RepositoryHttp.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresCatalog.scala
- docs/http-api.md
set.title: CX05.1: Return acceptance provenance on GET release
